svg.title: Two Equally Likely Arrangements
svg.desc: Two equally probable metaphase-I arrangements of unlinked chromosomes lead to PD or NPD. Original cell artwork retains its natural 858 by 508 proportions; all labels use normal text shaping. The four combinations and their two-spore brackets are retained.
svg.metadata: Original cell bitmap bytes preserved from the prior lecture SVG. Replace its inherited 1.20 horizontal stretch with equal scales; retain all stages, arrows, labels, and combination grouping. Construction: biological illustration handbook, Clarity; Mastering SVG, viewBox and viewport.
